latin: Ideo Ioseph ossibus tantum sepultus est et non corpore, quia eius ossa erant uirtutes et militie arboris superioris uocati Sadich influentis ad terram superiorem.
translation: Joseph's bones alone, not his body, were buried, because those bones were the powers and hosts of the higher tree named Tzaddik, whose influence flows into the higher earth.
